resolved.title: 创建新列
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Creating Columns[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Pandas allows us to create our own columns. 
For example, we can add a [b]month[/b] column based on the [b]date[/b] column:[code format="py" codeId="3236"]df['month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y").dt.month_name() [/code]
We do this by converting the [b]date[/b] column to datetime and extracting the month name from it, assigning the value to our new [b]month[/b] column.
[note]Our date is in DD.MM.YY format, which is why we need to specify the format attribute.[/note]

Pandas allows us to create our own columns. For example, we can add a month column based on the date column:

content.content:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")

df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)

df['month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y").dt.month_name()

df.set_index('date', inplace=True)

print(df.head())

resolved.title: 工作日
resolved.problem_statement_md:
继续处理加利福尼亚的COVID数据集。

现在，请添加一个新列，列名`weekday`。
然后，输出数据集的最后**7天的**数据。

不要在DataFrame上设置任何索引。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Weekdays [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You continue working with the COVID dataset for California. 
Now, add the [b]weekday names[/b] for each row as a new column, named '[b]weekday[/b]'. 
Then, output the last [b]7 days[/b] data of the dataset. 
Do not set any index on the DataFrame.
[note]The given code converts the date column to [b]datetime[/b], so you do not need to change its format. 
Use the .[b]dt.strftime("%A")[/b] function on the date column to convert it into a weekday name.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 示例代码将日期`date`列转换为**datetime**类型，你不需要改变它的格式。
- 在日期`date`列上使用`dt.strftime("%A")`函数，将其转换为工作日`weekday`。

code_templates.solution_code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")

df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")


df['weekday'] = df['date'].dt.strftime("%A")
print(df[-7:])
